questions.question: The maximum length of the femur is measured between which two points?

answers.a: Head of the femur and lesser trochanter
answers.b: Head of femur and medial condyle
answers.c: Most superior point of the head and most inferior point of medial condyle

explanations.a: The lesser trochanter is not used as the endpoint for measuring the maximum length of the femur.
explanations.b: The head of the femur and medial condyle are not the standard anatomical landmarks used for maximum femoral length.
explanations.c: Maximum femoral length is measured as the straight distance between the most superior point of the femoral head and the most inferior point of the medial condyle.
explanations.d: The greater trochanter and lateral condyle are not the standard endpoints for maximum femoral length.

questions.question: The standard instrument used to measure the maximum length of a femur is:

explanations.a: A sliding caliper is generally used for smaller linear measurements such as breadths and diameters.
explanations.b: A Vernier caliper is useful for precise smaller dimensions but is not the standard instrument for maximum femoral length.
explanations.c: A measuring tape is less suitable for obtaining a standardized straight-line measurement of a long bone.
explanations.d: An osteometric board is the standard instrument used to measure the maximum length of long bones such as the femur.

questions.question: Bicondylar length of the femur is measured from:

answers.a: Head of femur to medial condyle
answers.c: Head of femur to intercondylar notch
answers.d: Head of femur to a plane touching both condyles

explanations.a: The head of the femur to the medial condyle does not define the standard bicondylar length.
explanations.b: The greater trochanter is not used as the proximal reference point for bicondylar length.
explanations.c: The intercondylar notch is not the distal reference for this measurement.
explanations.d: Bicondylar length is measured from the head of the femur to a plane touching the most distal points of both femoral condyles.

questions.question: The vertical diameter of the head of femur is important for determining:

explanations.a: The vertical diameter of the femoral head is not primarily used for age determination.
explanations.b: The vertical diameter of the femoral head is an important anthropometric measurement used in sex estimation.
explanations.c: Although population variation can exist, this measurement is primarily useful for sex estimation rather than determining race.
explanations.d: The vertical diameter does not determine which side of the body the femur belongs to.
